cues.heading: Set your stance
cues.text: Stand with feet hip width apart. Use a stable support if needed.

cues.heading: Bend with control
cues.text: Move your bottom backwards as you bend your hips and knees.

cues.heading: Stay within your range
cues.text: Keep your heels down and your knees aligned with your toes.

cues.heading: Return to standing
cues.text: Push through both feet and straighten your hips and knees smoothly.

cues.heading: Choose the right depth
cues.text: Go only as low as prescribed. Do not bounce or push through sharp pain.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Only progress to this exercise when your physiotherapist has recommended it.
